propositions: Direct dependencies must be closed and merged before implementation start; upstream snapshot and execution-review contracts must be verified to exist before proceeding.
Focused prerequisite finder and verifier must receive prerequisite material only; general finder, verifier, and coach requests must contain neither prerequisite IDs nor prerequisite plan text.

Every readable pinned prerequisite must receive exactly one closed-schema disposition (consistent, finding, or indeterminate); general and focused verification index domains must be independently reshaped without shifting each other.

Missing or incorrect prerequisite attribution cannot produce a blocking finding; any indeterminate prerequisite record forces top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict while concurrent DET blockers remain visible in the blocking array.

Singleton focused-finder evaluation must achieve recall ≥0.90, false-acceptance ≤0.10, coverage=1.00, and attribution-error=0.00 before packed batching is implemented; packed recall must not regress from pinned singleton metrics.

Same-text findings from different prerequisite IDs must retain distinct finding IDs using the canonical four-field length-prefixed structured encoding; all non-prerequisite findings must preserve legacy pipe-delimited encoding byte-for-byte.
